exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct question tag.
exercises.explanationUz:
QUESTION TAGS (coursebook 108-bet
  18-mashq).

  TASDIQ gap → INKOR tag
  INKOR gap → TASDIQ tag
  Yordamchi fe'l TAKRORLANADI.

  1 was used → wasn't it?
  2 don't need → do you?
  3 've got → haven't they?
  4 can pay → can't I?
  5 is → isn't it?
  6 won't → will she?
  7 likes → doesn't he?
  8 isn't → is it?


⚠ 'SURFING ... IS' → 'isn't IT':

  Ega - V-ing (surfing) → 'it'.


⚠ 'MAINLY':

  = asosan.


⚠ 'A COMPUTER VIRUS':

  = kompyuter virusi.

items.textEn: At first the Internet was mainly used by scientists, ___?
You don't need a CD to send e-mail, ___?
They've already got a web site, ___?
I can pay for my ticket through the net, ___?
Surfing the net for information is so exciting, ___?
She won't download all those documents, ___?
Bob likes sending e-mail to his friends, ___?
That isn't a computer virus, ___?

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in a, an or the where necessary. (Use '-' for no article.)
exercises.instructionUz: Kerak bo'lgan joyda a, an yoki the qo'ying. (Artikl kerak bo'lmasa '-' yozing.)
exercises.explanationUz:
ARTIKLLAR (coursebook 108-bet
  16-mashq).

  A/AN - birinchi marta, noaniq,
    birlik: a terrible headache, a
    very unusual story, an e-mail
    message, a yacht, a holiday, a
    month, an excellent book
  THE - aniq, yagona, oldin
    aytilgan: the doctor, the net,
    the First World War, the
    Smiths, the Internet, THE book
    (2-marta), the story, the
    Canary Islands, the busiest
  ARTIKL YO'Q - umumiy ko'plik,
    mamlakatlar, stansiyalar:
    Most children, China, Britain,
    Victoria Station


⚠ 'THE CANARY ISLANDS':

  Orollar guruhi → THE.


⚠ 'THE SMITHS':

  Oila → THE + familiya + s.


⚠ 'VICTORIA STATION':

  Stansiya nomi → artiklsiz.


⚠ 'THE FIRST WORLD WAR':

  Tarixiy voqea → THE.

items.textEn: My father had ___ terrible headache, so he went to ___ doctor.
Is learning how to surf ___ net easy?
She told me ___ very unusual story.
Most ___ children today know how to use ___ computer.
How many years ago did ___ First World War take place?
Has Tom ever sent you ___ e-mail message?
Do ___ Smiths have ___ yacht?
If you want to visit ___ web site you have to enter ___ address.
A: Will you take ___ holiday this year? B: Yes, I will. I've decided to spend ___ month on ___ Canary Islands.
When was ___ Internet invented?
I read ___ excellent book last week. ___ book tells ___ story of ___ young girl who was born in ___ China.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'an excellent book' (1-marta); 'The book' (2-marta); 'the story of a young girl'; 'China' - artiklsiz.

items.textEn: ___ Victoria Station is one of ___ busiest stations in ___ Britain.

exercises.instructionEn: Correct the mistakes, as in the example. Example: There's the man standing at the door. → a
exercises.instructionUz: Xatolarni namunadagidek tuzating. Namuna: There's the man standing at the door. → a
exercises.explanationUz:
XATOLARNI TUZATISh - 15-UNIT
  JAMLANMASI.

  1 'There's THE man' → A (noaniq)
  2 'was you' → WERE you (tag)
  3 'What kind' → HOW kind (sifat →
    How)
  4 'said me' → ASKED me (savol)
  5 'a umbrella' → AN umbrella
  6 'How a naughty boy' → WHAT a
    naughty boy (ot → What a)
  7 'didn't she' → DID she (inkor
    gap → tasdiq tag)
  8 'don't to use' → NOT to use
    (ko'chirma buyruq)
  9 'That's a dog' → THE dog (aniq -
    tishlagan it)
  10 'too buy' → TO buy


⚠ 'NAUGHTY':

  = sho'x, tartibsiz.


⚠ 'TO BITE (BIT)':

  = tishlamoq.

items.textEn: There's the man standing at the door. → ___

items.whyUz: ⚠ Ko'chirma buyruq inkori: 'told me NOT TO use'.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the prompts below to write questions with question tags, as in the example: you/spend/a lot of your free time watching videos; you/have got/a lot of fans; your/fan-club web site/be/one of the most visited web sites on the net; you/not like/playing computer games; you/get engaged to/the singer Dee Brown last month. Example: You spend a lot of your free time watching videos, don't you?
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi ko'rsatmalar bilan question tag'li savollar yozing, namunadagidek: you/spend/a lot of your free time watching videos; you/have got/a lot of fans; your/fan-club web site/be/one of the most visited web sites on the net; you/not like/playing computer games; you/get engaged to/the singer Dee Brown last month. Namuna: Bo'sh vaqtingizning ko'p qismini video ko'rib o'tkazasiz, shundaymi?
exercises.explanationUz:
INTERVYU - QUESTION TAGS.

  1 You spend ..., DON'T YOU?
  2 You've got a lot of fans,
    HAVEN'T YOU?
  3 Your web site is one of ...,
    ISN'T IT?
  4 You don't like playing ..., DO
    YOU?
  5 You got engaged to Dee Brown
    last month, DIDN'T YOU?

  ⚠ Javobga qarang: 'Yes, I do' →
  'don't you?'; 'Yes, I have' →
  'haven't you?'; 'Yes, it is' →
  'isn't it?'; 'No' → 'do you?'


⚠ 'TO GET ENGAGED TO':

  = ... bilan unashtirilmoq.


⚠ 'A FAN-CLUB':

  = muxlislar klubi.


⚠ 'THAT'S PRIVATE':

  = bu shaxsiy.


⚠ 'I GET FOLLOWED BY FANS':

  = muxlislar meni kuzatib yuradi
  (get + V3 = majhul).

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.en: I'd like to welcome Chris Newton to the studio this morning. Your fans want to know all about what you do in your free time. 1) ___
lines.answer: You spend a lot of your free time watching videos, don't you?
lines.uz: Bugun ertalab studiyamizga Kris Nyutonni taklif qilmoqchiman. Muxlislaringiz bo'sh vaqtingizda nima qilishingizni bilmoqchi. Bo'sh vaqtingizning ko'p qismini video ko'rib o'tkazasiz, shundaymi?

lines.speaker: Chris
lines.en: Yes, I do. I prefer the cinema but I get followed by fans everywhere I go now.
lines.uz: Ha. Kinoni afzal ko'raman, lekin endi qayerga bormay muxlislar meni kuzatib yurishadi.

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.answer: You've got a lot of fans, haven't you?

lines.speaker: Chris
lines.en: Yes, I have. Sometimes I can't believe how much mail I get!
lines.uz: Ha. Ba'zan qancha xat olishimga ishonolmayman!

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.answer: Your fan-club web site is one of the most visited web sites on the net, isn't it?
lines.uz: Muxlislar klubingiz veb-sayti internetdagi eng ko'p tashrif buyuriladigan saytlardan biri, shundaymi?

lines.speaker: Chris
lines.en: Yes, it is. I love reading e-mail from my fans.
lines.uz: Ha. Muxlislarimdan kelgan xatlarni o'qishni yaxshi ko'raman.

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.answer: You don't like playing computer games, do you?
lines.whyUz: ⚠ 'don't like' (inkor) → 'do you?' Javob: 'No, that's not true'.

lines.speaker: Chris
lines.en: No, that's not true. I love playing computer games. It's great fun.
lines.uz: Yo'q, bu to'g'ri emas. Kompyuter o'yinlarini yaxshi ko'raman. Juda qiziq.

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.answer: You got engaged to the singer Dee Brown last month, didn't you?
lines.uz: O'tgan oy qo'shiqchi Di Braun bilan unashtirildingiz, shundaymi?

lines.speaker: Chris
lines.en: I'm sorry. I don't want to talk about Dee. That's private.
lines.uz: Kechirasiz. Di haqida gapirishni xohlamayman. Bu shaxsiy.

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.en: Oh ... okay. Well, thanks for coming into the studio to talk to us. Now, let's hear your latest song ...
lines.uz: O ... xo'p. Studiyamizga kelib gaplashganingiz uchun rahmat. Endi eng yangi qo'shig'ingizni eshitaylik ...

patterns.formula: TASDIQ GAP, + inkor tag? / INKOR GAP, + tasdiq tag?
patterns.exampleEn: Bob likes sending e-mail, doesn't he? She won't download them, will she?
patterns.exampleUz: Bob e-mail yuborishni yoqtiradi, shundaymi? U ularni yuklab olmaydi, shundaymi?

patterns.formula: You've got ..., haven't you? / You got ..., didn't you?
patterns.exampleEn: You've got a lot of fans, haven't you?

patterns.formula: I read a book. The book tells the story of a girl.
patterns.exampleEn: I read an excellent book last week. The book tells the story of a young girl.
patterns.exampleUz: O'tgan hafta a'lo kitob o'qidim. Kitob yosh qiz hikoyasini aytadi.

patterns.formula: How + SIFAT + of you! / What a + SIFAT + OT!
patterns.exampleEn: How kind of you to invite us! What a naughty boy he is!
patterns.exampleUz: Bizni taklif qilganingiz qanday mehribonlik! U qanday sho'x bola!
